key_insight: Crystoria links thermodynamic and phonon-based dynamical stability information across 2.65 million crystal structures for materials AI.
engineering_relevance: The dataset can support AI screening of candidate materials beyond energy alone by incorporating dynamical stability.
method: Curate low-energy and metastable inorganic crystals and standardize structural identities.
Screen dynamical stability using phonon calculations.
evidence_signal: Crystoria contains 2,649,640 structures spanning 89 elements, 219 space groups, and 1–48 atoms per primitive cell; 1,793,353 structures (67.68%) are classified as dynamically stable.
watch_item: The abstract does not specify phonon-screening thresholds or validation against higher-fidelity calculations, which are important when interpreting stability labels.
paper_title: Crystoria: A Large-Scale Crystal Dataset Linking Thermodynamic and Dynamical Stability for Materials AI
